reply:
Sunset in Portland, Oregon today (Sunday, Oct 11, 2026) is at 6:31:57 PM PDT — that's from a direct read of sunrise-sunset.org's Portland page just now. A broader web search I ran first corroborated this, with other sources (including a geotimedate.org listing) converging on roughly 6:31–6:33 PM PDT for the same date, so the ~6:32 PM PDT figure is solid.

Sources:
- https://sunrise-sunset.org/us/portland-or
- https://geotimedate.org/sun/usa/or/portland
